tip_droplet: Event coming up — click to view
err_time: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 14:30.
err_generic: An unexpected error occurred. Details were written to the log.
err_interval: Enter a number of days from 1 to 365.
msg_select_task: Please select a task in the list first.
msg_confirm_delete: Delete the task “{0}”? It will stay in the history.
msg_confirm_restore: Current data will be replaced with the selected backup. A backup of the current data will be made first. Continue?
droplet_body: Please don't miss the planned task and get ready for it.
due_title: IT'S TIME! Your event is now
toast_missed: Events that came up while the app was not running: {0}
quiet_hint: Sounds are turned off for the chosen period; visual notifications stay on.
voice_confirm: You planned: {0}. Date: {1}. Time: {2}. Save the task?
voice_test_phrase: Voice test. This is how task confirmations will sound.
voice_lang: Speech language (separate from the interface language)
voice_say: Press the button and say your task, e.g. “Tomorrow at 3 pm call the doctor”
voice_heard: Recognized. Please check the result below.
voice_no_title: Could not find a task title. Try rephrasing.
voice_ambiguous: Please confirm the time: morning or afternoon/evening?
voice_type_instead: You can type the phrase instead.
speech_online: No speech recognizer is installed in Windows for this language. Windows online recognition will be used and needs internet. To work offline, add the language and its speech pack: Windows Settings → Time & language → Language & region.
speech_no_mic: No microphone found or it is unavailable. Check the connection and microphone permission in Windows privacy settings.
speech_network: No internet connection, and this language needs online recognition.
speech_policy: “Online speech recognition” is turned off in Windows. Enable it: Settings → Privacy & security → Speech.
speech_unsupported: Speech recognition for this language is not available on this computer.
tts_no_voice: There is no Windows voice for this language — the default voice was used. Install one: Settings → Time & language → Speech.
weather_offline_note: No internet connection: showing the last data received.
set_language_hint: Changes immediately, no restart needed. Your tasks are not translated — they stay in the language you wrote them in.
set_tts_on: Read the recognized task aloud and ask for confirmation
set_repeat_min: Repeat the signal every (minutes) until the task is done
err_repeat_min: The repeat interval must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
set_reminders_info: The main reminder fires exactly at the scheduled time: a Windows notification, a card and a sound. The signal repeats until the task is done.
set_reminders_info2: You can snooze for 10, 30 or 60 minutes. Events missed while the computer was off or asleep are shown in one summary notification.
set_droplet_on: Show the droplet before an event
err_warn_min: Enter a number of minutes from 5 to 1440.
set_weather_hint: Weather comes from the Open-Meteo service and is used only for the bottom bar. The calendar, tasks, clock and reminders work without internet.
set_quiet_on: Mute sounds every day during these hours
set_quiet_hint: During quiet hours no sound is played, but notifications and cards are still shown.
set_backup_on: Create an automatic backup once a day
set_close_tray: The close button hides to the tray (reminders keep working)
set_min_tray: Minimize to the tray instead of the taskbar
